instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for how to request a prescription refill and save the instructions in a text file named prescription_refill.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for how to request a prescription refill.
Open a relevant healthcare, pharmacy, or government website.
Find the instructions for requesting a prescription refill.
Type or copy the refill instructions into the document.
Save the file as prescription_refill.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.
